name: Navy Harris Tweed Scorecard Holder
why: Harris Tweed wrapped around a toffee-leather lining, made in Beaverton, OR. Folds to 4.5 x 6.5 in. for a back pocket, takes a standard 5.75 in. card and now has a built-in pencil holder.

name: Hand Forged Anvil Steel Ball Marker
why: Each coin is heated to roughly 2,200 degrees and shaped on an anvil with hammers, chisels and punches, then sanded, buffed and tumbled one at a time, so no two are alike. 1.5 in. diameter.

name: Loma | Toasted Almond Par 3 Bag
why: A single-strap par-3 bag with a 2-way top divider for up to 6 clubs, a full-length divider, an insulated 2-can cooler pocket and a velour-lined valuables pocket. Pitched for a par-3 round, a range session or a quick nine.

name: Original Jones Bag - Navy/White
why: The bag that started Jones in 1971, built for the walking golfer: water-resistant nylon, a retro single strap and an unstructured body.

name: Ball Marker 1802 Sterling Silver American Flag
why: Sterling silver, engraved by hand in Texas with an American flag on one face and classic scroll engraving on the reverse.
